steps.en: Choose a template for the transaction and jurisdiction
steps.zh: 按交易与法域选择模板

steps.en: Provide Markdown clauses and a paired Word original
steps.zh: 提供 Markdown 条款与配对 Word 原件

steps.en: Customize fields and review all terms with counsel
steps.zh: 定制字段并与律师审阅全部条款

steps.en: Compare the final draft to the original before signing
steps.zh: 签署前核对最终稿与原件

value.en: Start from inspectable clauses rather than invented contract text
value.zh: 从可核对条款起稿，而非临时编造合同
